name: Inspect HDD client
command: set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca 'set -u; cd ~/Upload-Assistant-wastaken; printf "checkout="; pwd; ls -la | head -40; echo containers:; podman ps -a --format "{{.Names}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Status}}"; echo config-files:; find docker-data -maxdepth 2 -type f -name "config.py*" -printf "%p\n" 2>/dev/null | sort; echo compose:; podman compose -f docker-compose.local.yml ps 2>&1 || true; echo health:; curl -sS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:12345/api/health || true'
description: Inspect the migrated Destiny HDD checkout, container, persistent config, and WebUI health.
